text:
Alyssa: Kicking off POC with Nimbus Health — they want streaming SDK + function/tool-calls + structured JSON output for downstream ingestion. Main asks: SSO (SAML), KMS for PHI, reserved capacity pricing, and SOC2/legal answers. Anyone able to own integration + perf?
Tom H: I can take SDK integration. Which languages to prioritize?
Priya S: They'll start with Python for demo; Node after. Blockers flagged by customer: SAML SSO, on-prem option for certain workflows, and KMS/HSM for keys.
Kevin L: For SSO we have a SAML metadata and SP config. @Alyssa -- can you drop their IdP metadata? Also infra note: streaming+tool-calls with structured output is supported but need to confirm model/quant profile for latency.
Alyssa: Uploaded IdP metadata + security questionnaire draft to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/nimbus-poc (see tab "security-answers").
PresalesBot: Ticket created: POC-3124. Assigned: Alyssa, Tom H. Due: 2026-04-01. SLA tier: enterprise.
Matt R: Quick Python SDK snippet for streaming + tool call + structured output (small example):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
with client.streaming.generate(model="rw-small-quant", stream=True) as s:
    s.call_tool("invoice_parser", {"invoice_pdf_url": url})
    for chunk in s:
        if chunk.type == "tool_output":
            print(chunk.json)  # should be JSON matching schema
```
Tom H: Nice. Couple of engineering notes: we should add a simple schema validator in the harness to fail the run if output doesn't match. Also provide a curl example for non-SDK customers.
Kevin L: Nimbus estimates steady 50 rps streaming requests, with bursts up to 200. For reserved capacity pricing we'll need to size for 50 rps p50 <= 200ms target; fallback to hosted smaller model under load. @Tom H can we bench with rw-small-quant and a 2x-CPU batcher?
Tom H: Yup, I'll run a perf harness today and post results to the drive.
Priya S: Security/legal asks: signed DPA, SOC2 report, pen test summary, and documented KMS flow showing separation of PHI keys. I'll complete questionnaire section 3 (encryption/key mgmt) and ping Legal for DPA.
Alyssa: Acceptance criteria for the POC we agreed to share with customer: 1) streaming pipeline demo with function/tool-calls returning structured JSON validated against the schema; 2) perf: p50 < 200ms at 50 rps; 3) SAML SSO test completed; 4) contractually: DPA signed + SOC2 on file. Can we aim demo next Wed 10am PT?
Tom H: Demo time works. I'll have harness + sample payloads.
Kevin L: I'll draft a fallback runbook: dedicated -> canary autoscale -> hosted small model. Also estimating Dedicated commit: rough draft 2k GPU hours/month for baseline, will refine after perf run.
PresalesBot: Reminder: please add billing contact to POC-3124 to generate formal estimate.
Matt R: Dropping a short latency test command in the drive (tools/perf): `wrk -t8 -c100 -d60 --script stream.lua http://perf-test.local`
Alyssa: Great work — on it. @Kevin L please share refined commit estimate by EOD and I'll loop Legal + Customer Success. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Kevin L: On it, will post numbers by 1700 PT.
Priya S: I'll finish security QA answers and ping Legal now.
Tom H: Uploading initial perf artifacts in 30m.
Alyssa: Closing the loop here — will update Nimbus and schedule the demo once we have perf + legal confirmations.
